title: Disclosures
outcomes: State the objective and significant judgement disclosures.
Prepare disclosures about subsidiaries and NCI.
Prepare disclosures about joint arrangements and associates.
Disclose unconsolidated structured entities and Schedule III requirements.

meta.exam_tip: Group disclosure answers should cover judgements, NCI, restrictions, and structured entity exposure.

concepts.title: Objective and significant judgements
body: Ind AS 112 aims for disclosures that help users evaluate the nature of, and risks associated with, interests in other entities, and the effects of those interests on the financial position, performance and cash flows.

Entities disclose significant judgements and assumptions in deciding: whether they control another entity; have joint control or significant influence; and the type of joint arrangement when structured through a separate vehicle.

Typical examples: control with less than half the votes, no control with more than half, significant influence below 20%, and being an agent or principal. Investment entities disclose judgements about that status.
concepts.analogy: Explain the hard calls behind the group structure.
concepts.work: Consolidating a 45% investee needs a stated reason.

concepts.title: Interests in subsidiaries
body: For subsidiaries: the composition of the group; for each subsidiary with material NCI — name, principal place of business, NCI ownership and voting shares, profit allocated to NCI, accumulated NCI and summarised financial information (including dividends to NCI).
Significant restrictions on access to or use of group assets and settling liabilities (e.g. regulatory limits on dividends); risks from consolidated structured entities (e.g. support commitments).
Consequences of changes in ownership without loss of control (schedule of effects on parent equity), and gains or losses on loss of control with the portion from remeasuring retained interest.
concepts.analogy: Show outsiders' stakes and the strings on group assets.
concepts.work: A foreign subsidiary unable to remit cash must disclose the restriction.

concepts.title: Interests in joint arrangements and associates
body: For each material joint arrangement and associate: name, nature of relationship, principal place of business, ownership interest, and measurement method (equity method or fair value).

For each material joint venture and associate: dividends received and summarised financial information; for joint ventures, more detail (cash, current financial liabilities, depreciation, interest, tax). Fair value if quoted prices exist.
Aggregate information for individually immaterial ones; commitments and contingent liabilities relating to joint ventures and associates; unrecognised share of losses.
concepts.analogy: Material investees get their own summary figures.
concepts.work: Unrecognised losses in an associate are disclosed.

concepts.title: Unconsolidated structured entities and Schedule III
body: A structured entity is designed so that voting rights are not the dominant factor in deciding who controls it (e.g. securitisation vehicles, certain funds). For unconsolidated structured entities in which an entity has interests: nature, purpose, size, activities, financing; carrying amounts of assets and liabilities recognised; maximum exposure to loss and how it is determined; and support provided.
Sponsored structured entities with no interest at year end: how the entity decides which it sponsors, income earned and assets transferred.

Division II of Schedule III to the Companies Act also requires, in consolidated statements, a table showing each entity's share of net assets and profit or loss (and OCI and total comprehensive income) as a percentage of consolidated amounts, including NCI, associates and joint ventures.
concepts.analogy: Off-balance-sheet vehicles need risk disclosures; Schedule III adds an entity-wise table.
concepts.work: A bank sponsoring a securitisation trust discloses its maximum exposure.

jobs.title: Preparing Ind AS 112 notes
jobs.situation: Group has 20 subsidiaries, 3 JVs, 5 associates and 2 securitisation trusts.
steps: List significant judgements on control and influence.
Prepare summarised financial information for material JVs and associates.
Disclose exposure to unconsolidated structured entities.
jobs.takeaway: Materiality decides which investees get individual disclosure.

mcqs.q: Ind AS 112 requires disclosure of significant judgements about:
options: Control, joint control and significant influence
mcqs.explain: Judgements behind the structure. In practice: unusual percentages.

mcqs.q: For subsidiaries with material NCI, the entity discloses:
options: Summarised financial information and NCI share of profit
mcqs.explain: Detailed NCI information. In practice: by subsidiary.

mcqs.q: A structured entity is one where:
options: Voting rights are not the dominant factor in control
mcqs.explain: Contracts usually decide. In practice: securitisation vehicles.
mcqs.topic: Unconsolidated structured entities and Schedule III

mcqs.q: For unconsolidated structured entities, the entity discloses:
mcqs.explain: Risk-focused disclosure. In practice: explain how determined.
mcqs.topic: Unconsolidated structured entities and Schedule III

mcqs.q: Significant restrictions on using group assets are disclosed under:
mcqs.explain: Part of Ind AS 112. In practice: regulatory capital.

mcqs.q: Unrecognised share of losses of an associate is:
mcqs.explain: Users need the exposure. In practice: for the period and cumulatively.
mcqs.topic: Interests in joint arrangements and associates

mcqs.q: Schedule III Division II requires, in consolidated statements:
options: Each entity's share of net assets and profit as a percentage
mcqs.explain: Additional Indian requirement. In practice: include associates and JVs.
mcqs.topic: Unconsolidated structured entities and Schedule III

mcqs.q: Effects of changes in ownership without loss of control are disclosed as:
options: A schedule of effects on parent's equity
mcqs.explain: Equity transactions are visible. In practice: show consideration and NCI change.

viva.q: What is the objective of Ind AS 112?
viva.model: To help users evaluate the nature and risks of interests in other entities and their effects on position, performance and cash flows.

viva.q: What is disclosed for material NCI?
viva.model: Name, place of business, NCI share of ownership and votes, profit allocated, accumulated NCI and summarised financial information.
One designed so that voting or similar rights are not what decides who controls it, with relevant activities directed by contracts.

viva.q: What is disclosed for material joint ventures?
viva.model: Name, relationship, ownership, method, dividends received and summarised financial information with extra detail like cash and depreciation.

viva.q: What does Schedule III add for groups?
viva.model: A table of each entity's share of consolidated net assets and profit as percentages and amounts.

cases.title: Granite Group
cases.case: Granite Ltd. has a 60% subsidiary in a country with currency controls limiting dividends, a 50% joint venture with summarised net assets of ₹400 crore, and has sponsored a securitisation trust (unconsolidated) in which it holds a ₹15 crore subordinated note.

mcqs.q: The currency controls are disclosed as:
mcqs.explain: They limit access to group assets. In practice: quantify where possible.

mcqs.q: Granite's share of the JV's net assets (₹ crore):
mcqs.explain: 50% × 400, reconciled to carrying amount. In practice: summarised information.
mcqs.topic: Interests in joint arrangements and associates

mcqs.q: Maximum exposure to loss from the trust, with no guarantees given (₹ crore):
mcqs.explain: The carrying amount of the note. In practice: add any guarantees or commitments.
mcqs.topic: Unconsolidated structured entities and Schedule III

mcqs.explain: Control is not via votes. In practice: Ind AS 112 risk disclosures.
mcqs.topic: Unconsolidated structured entities and Schedule III
